name: Jade Triad (Yakuza Gang)
body:
A yakuza who belongs to this gang understands that the only true rule is fear. If they are not feared by both their allies and enemies alike, they are nothing.

Edict: The yakuza must show no mercy, regardless of the situation. They must enact swift and brutal retribution for any slight against him, leaving behind evidence of their kill. Shows of dominance and power are paramount to a jade triad yakuza, and all those who know of them must know of their prowess in the killing arts.

Sneak Attack: Whenever a jade triad yakuza makes an attack against a demoralized foe which would qualify for sneak attack damage, they gain a +2 competence bonus to attack rolls against that foe.

Skills: Whenever a jade triad yakuza uses the Intimidate skill to demoralize a foe, they receive a bonus on the check equal to 1/3 their yakuza level (minimum +1).

Gang Abilities: A yakuza belonging to this gang gains the following abilities as they increases in level:

Fearful Fang (Ex)

At 2nd level, a jade triad yakuza can make an Intimidate check to demoralize a foe as a swift action whenever they deal sneak attack damage.

Terror Bite (Su)

At 8th level, once per day whenever a jade triad yakuza makes an Intimidate check to demoralize a foe, they can instead make that foe frightened for the duration of their demoralization. If they spend 1 point from their ki, they can demoralize a foe normally immune to fear effects. At 12th level and every 4 levels afterwards, they can use this ability an additional time.

Nightmare Blade (Ex)

At 15th level, whenever a jade triad yakuza deals sneak attack damage to a demoralized foe, all sneak attack dice which come up as a 1 can be rerolled. These dice can only be rerolled once, and they must accept the new result of this roll. They can spend 1 point from their ki to instead reroll all dice that come up as a 1 or 2 and reroll until they come up as a 3 or higher.
